subject: Error: Failed to match some capture locations to detector sites

messages.author: aa54ffe118d70049
messages.subject: Error: Failed to match some capture locations to detector sites
parts:
Greetings,
I am working in SECR for the first time on white-tailed deer fecal samples. I have done the sampling in plots. I am trying to make my read.capthist; the data is loading correctly and giving me the right number of observations but it is giving an error code. 
Note: When I run this same data without effort then no errors are found.

I have included my data, code, and outputs. Thanks!

# includes effort but does not include sex
spscov <- read.capthist(captfile= "nonecapt.txt", trapfile= "playdata.txt",
                        detector = "count", fmt = "trapID", binary.usage= FALSE)

    Session AnimalID Occ Trap
1         1        A   3  8-2
2         1        A   3  9-2
9         1        B   1  4-3
3         1        B   2  4-1
------omitted for space----
124       1       3N   2 16-1
125       1       3O   1 16-2
126       1       3P   2 16-2
127       1       3Q   1 16-3
128       1       3R   1 16-3
129       1       3S   1 16-3
130       1       3T   3 16-4

Error in make.capthist(capt, trps, fmt = fmt, noccasions = noccasions,  :
  failed to match some capture locations to detector sites

Best, 
Ashley

messages.author: a8bab4bedf10245c
messages.subject: Re: Error: Failed to match some capture locations to detector sites
parts:
Just looking at this quickly, it seems like the trapIDs in your trap file don't match the trapIDs in your capture file.  I.e., in the traps file, you have detector names as "S11", "S32" etc, but in your captures file you have them as "8-2", "16-3", etc.

The removal of effort from the trap file doesn't make this work, at least on my end.  Perhaps there's a mistake in the trap coding that got passed to the effort trap file but not the non-effort one?  Can't say for sure since you didn't include the working one.

Thanks,

Scott
